title: Verify restricted SEO Preview candidate locally
summary: Local read-only restrictions pass security, build, HTTP and browser validation. Hosted credentials and real staging acceptance remain unexecuted; no deployment or SMTP change.

changes.detail: Fail-closed GET/HEAD route and staging REST allowlists, restrictive browser policy and separate disabled hosted acceptance plan.
Disable Preview browser auth transport/session restoration and side-effect layout components; serve local images directly in Preview. Existing production behavior and email guards retained.

Cover posts sitemap shards and Unicode product slugs, preserve encoded local image paths, and verify actual browser image decoding. Corrected harness export/networkidle issues; rebuilt after sandbox font denial.

validation.name: Synthetic production-mode build and TypeScript
validation.detail: 226 pages; final TypeScript check passed. Existing lint warnings remain.

validation.name: Regression and safety suites
validation.detail: 120 regression, 19 credential isolation, 18 email safety, 12 verifier/error handling, 13 read-only boundary and 2 fixture transport tests.

validation.name: Fixture acceptance and browser images
validation.detail: 37 checks, including four browser pages with no page errors or unexpected routed requests, product-image decoding, and 30 image response hashes.

validation.name: Preservation
validation.detail: 2588 original recovery files and 30 repaired images unchanged; 127 service consumers retain selectors. Production untouched.

validation.name: Provider metadata
validation.detail: Read-only audit confirms staging identity/scopes/disable flags and disabled Auth email settings. No credential values read.

validation.name: Hosted operations
validation.detail: Hosted credential verifier, actual staging-backed acceptance and deployment require separate authorization. No provider-wide SMTP isolation or OS egress firewall claim.
